nodes.long_description:
SEGi Universe is an immersive virtual campus experience created for SEGi University students. Step into a digital version of the university where you can explore campus environments, interact with fellow students, and participate in university activities in virtual reality.

Connect with friends through real-time voice communication, discover campus spaces, and join live sessions, events, and community gatherings from anywhere. SEGi Universe brings learning, collaboration, and social interaction together in a shared virtual world designed to enhance the student experience.

Features
🏫 Explore a virtual SEGi University campus
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Meet and interact with fellow students
🎤 Real-time voice communication
🎓 Attend live sessions and university events
🌐 Social and collaborative virtual environment
🚀 Continuous updates and new features planned

SEGi Universe is designed to create a connected, engaging, and innovative digital campus experience, helping students learn, socialize, and collaborate beyond the boundaries of the physical campus.

Version 1.0 – Initial Release. More locations, activities, customization options, and student-focused experiences will be added in future updates.
nodes.short_description: Meet friends, explore campus, and join live sessions in the SEGi Universe.

nodes.change_log:
SEGi Universe – Release Notes (v11.0)

We are excited to introduce the latest update to SEGi Universe, bringing an even more immersive and engaging virtual campus experience for SEGi University students. In this version, students can now explore additional areas of the campus, including the Library, Front Exterior Walkway, Back Exterior Walkway, and fully accessible Classrooms, creating a more realistic and interactive digital university environment. The update also introduces Live Podcast Sessions and Live Lecture Sessions for signed-in users, allowing students to participate in educational content, discussions, and events directly within the virtual world. To enhance the overall experience, all 3D models have been fully optimized for improved performance, smoother navigation, and better visual quality across supported devices. Additionally, networking and voice communication have been further refined to provide a more stable multiplayer experience, reduced latency, improved avatar responsiveness, and greater overall system stability. With these improvements, SEGi Universe continues to evolve as a social and educational metaverse where students can explore, learn, connect, and collaborate in a shared virtual campus.
